tasks.short: Explain drawings to the construction team.

steps.what: Open the drawings the team will see.
Explain the drawings and note the adjustments.
Record the adjustments the drafter agreed.

tasks.design: The current drawings are opened from {DOCS} before the meeting. The drafter explains them to the production or construction team and provides adjustments in the room. The set is not a script. An adjustment is recorded only when the drafter writes it. Nothing is reissued from this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The team worked from a paper set that was not the latest, and adjustments lived in the margin.
tasks.enabler_now: The current set can be the one opened. The explanation is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: A question the drawing does not answer, and an adjustment that needs the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see which question is a reading problem and which is a design change.
tasks.altitude: The current set is the one in the room. The explanation and the adjustments stay with the drafter.

reach.task: Walk a crew through a drawing and write the adjustment.
reach.learn: The set can be current. The explanation cannot.

evidence.claim: The current drawing set can be opened for a meeting. It cannot explain the drawing.
An adjustment that changes the work is the drafter's note. The screen must not reissue a sheet from the conversation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Sheet id and revision id, produced by the issued set. A meeting with no revision id still happens. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the issued set the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Who on site may ask for an adjustment.
Which adjustments need the engineer before they are noted.
research_questions: Is the issued revision the one the site holds?
What share of questions change the drawing?

already_counted.description: The drafter still explains the drawings.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a sheet the set missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is opening the current set. It disappears when the revision is unclear and the drafter sorts paper. The explanation time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the list of measurements the design still needs.
Visit the job site and assemble the measurements.
File the measurements against the architectural designs.

tasks.design: A list of missing measurements is opened from {DOCS} when the design already names them. The drafter visits the job site and assembles the data. A number is filed only after that visit. The list does not complete the architectural design. A gap the list does not name is still measured if the drafter sees it.
tasks.previous_blocker: The return from site was a notebook, transcribed later, sometimes against the wrong sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Named gaps can be a list. The visit is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: A dimension the building does not present cleanly, and a design question found only on site.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see that a requested dimension is not the one that matters.
tasks.altitude: The list can be ready. The visit and the measurements stay with the drafter. Filing follows the visit.

reach.task: Take a measurement on site and file it against the job.
reach.learn: The list can name a gap. The visit cannot be skipped.

evidence.claim: A list can name measurements the design file already asks for. It cannot visit the site.
A filed number without the visit is not a measurement. The design is not completed by the list.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Gap id, produced by the design file. An empty list does not cancel the visit. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the design file the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Which sites the drafter may enter.
Which measurements a surveyor must take instead.
research_questions: What share of measurements are known before the visit?
How are site numbers checked against the sheet?

already_counted.description: The drafter still visits and measures.
The drafter still files the numbers.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a measurement the list did not name.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the list of known gaps. It disappears when the design names nothing and the drafter decides what to measure on site. The visit is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Lay out interior rooms for a commercial building.

steps.what: Open the commercial building brief and the area figures.
Lay out interior room arrangements on the drafting system.
Check the arrangements against the brief.

tasks.design: The brief and the area figures are opened from {DOCS}. The drafter lays out the interior room arrangements for the commercial building on the drawing model in {OTHER}. The figures do not place a room. A brief with no areas is still drawn by the drafter from what the architect has said.
tasks.previous_blocker: Room areas were in a note, and the layout started by copying the last commercial plan.
tasks.enabler_now: The brief and the areas can be one pack. The layout is still drawn.
tasks.still_hard: A use the brief does not name, and a circulation conflict the areas do not show.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see areas that add up and a plan that does not work.
tasks.altitude: The brief is together. The interior layout is still the drafter's drawing. Nothing is issued.

reach.task: Set the brief and expect the room layout to be drawn.
reach.learn: The areas can be listed. The arrangement cannot.

evidence.claim: A brief can hold area figures. It cannot lay out rooms.

Producing the drawing stays with the drafter. A rule list does not pass a design. An engineer signs a code conclusion. For a new class 1 building, an independent kwaliteitsborger still tests against the building rules. This list does not replace that test.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Brief id and area figure, produced by the project file. A brief with no areas is not auto-laid-out. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project file the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Which commercial rules apply to this use.
research_questions: Are area figures filed against the brief?
What share of layouts are redrawn after the first review?

already_counted.description: The drafter still lays out the rooms.
The drafter still checks the brief.

incremental.description: The drafter adds an area the brief missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is opening the brief and the areas. It disappears when the areas are not filed and the drafter takes them from a meeting. The layout time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Represent the architect on the construction site.

steps.what: Open the design specifications the builder is working to.
Represent the architect on the construction site.
Record builder compliance notes and design corrections.

tasks.design: The design specifications are opened from {DOCS} before the visit. The drafter represents the architect or the engineer on the construction site, under their supervision, and advises on design corrections. Compliance is what the drafter saw. The pack does not pass the builder's work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The site copy of the specification was old, and corrections were phoned back without a note.
tasks.enabler_now: The current specification can be the pack. The visit is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: Work that is covered, and a correction the architect has not accepted.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see work that matches a line and still breaks the design.
tasks.altitude: The current specification is in the bag. The representation on site stays with the drafter. No compliance is marked from the desk.

reach.task: Supervise the drafter who stands in on site.
reach.learn: The pack can be current. The site judgement cannot move.

evidence.claim: A specification pack can be opened for a site visit. It cannot represent the architect.
Builder compliance and a design correction are what the drafter saw and advised. The screen must not pass the work. The architect or engineer still supervises.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Specification id and revision, produced by the issued set. A visit with no revision still happens. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the issued specification the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Whether the drafter may advise a correction without the architect present.
Which work must wait for the kwaliteitsborger.
research_questions: Is the site copy the current revision?
Which corrections are later rejected by the architect?

already_counted.description: The drafter still represents the architect on site.
The drafter still writes the note.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a specification sheet the pack missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the specification pack. It disappears when the revision is disputed and the drafter carries paper. The site time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Explaining a drawing and standing on site stay with the drafter. Measurements can be filed after the visit, and an interior layout is still drawn by the person.
reach: Surveying and mapping technicians take measurements, and this job learns a filed number is not the visit.
Architects walk a site with the drafter, and this job learns the advice on a correction is still spoken.
skills_to_grow: File a measurement only after the visit that produced it.
Explain a drawing in the room, and keep the adjustment as a noted change.
role.ambitious_version: A site visit files its measurements the same day, and the drawing explanation is still given by the drafter.
